claims.statement: controlsd waits for serialized CarParams and StarPilotCarParams, selects the longitudinal and lateral controllers, subscribes to StarPilot services, and publishes carControl, controlsState, and starpilotLateralState.
The StarPilot planner aggregates feature outputs into a starpilotPlan message containing acceleration, cruise, lateral-check, speed-limit, and toggle state consumed by downstream control code.
The shared lateral controller treats saturation as meaningful only when it is not caused by safety limiting, driver steering input, or curvature limiting.
Vehicle integration applies StarPilot access and parameter policy before selecting a vehicle interface and obtaining standard and StarPilot-specific car parameters.

The repository contains focused tests for StarPilot controls, Ford lateral behavior, car interfaces, and fleet/safety behavior, but those tests are source-level evidence rather than physical-vehicle validation.
